note: Whole tissue sections measured by Xenium and then Visium HD on the same section, other than the four Vannan cores. The builders read this list: to add a section, copy its ring-run rows files (fpr.py output for the H&E and the Xenium nuclei) under ring/ and add an entry. Rows files hold, per surface, f0 (nuclei: dip) and f1-f3 (ring widths 1-3: peak and dip) with the truth shift. Each section has a group: discovery sections count in regchkFringeHe*; confirmation sections (tested after the ring width was fixed) are kept separate and count in regchkFringeConfirm*.
